integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: fire on TK-7104 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7104, LT-7104 and PSV-7104 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 5 May 2021 an incident occurred on TK-7104, LT-7104 and PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
